verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing API allows programmatic access to contacts/campaigns (mailchimp-docs-4), which could support data export, but there's no documented bulk/open-format export-and-leave feature, and community reports describe accounts being banned or deleted with contact lists lost entirely, support falsely claiming data was wiped, and only providing a data dump under public pressure — directly contradicting a smooth 'export all my data and leave' experience. Missing for 10: an official bulk export/data-portability doc, an open standard export format, and confirmation that account closure preserves user access to their data.
